adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the new guests are persisted first via `prisma.booking.update(... attendees.createMany ...)` (around the `bookingAttendees` update). After that, `await eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking);` is executed outside of any try/catch. If the calendar provider update throws, the mutation will error even though the DB write already succeeded. A retry would then compute `uniqueGuests` by filtering out emails already present in `booking.attendees`, leading to `uniqueGuests.length === 0` and a `BAD_REQUEST` with `emails_must_be_unique_valid`. This matches the finding’s described failure mode and is directly verifiable from the diff.
